lines.text: باشد و اینها هم بملاحظه استعداد قوابل باز بسته بود فتامل (فصل دهم)
lines.en: And these too, considering the capacity of the recipients, are dependent. So reflect. (Chapter Ten)

lines.text: در احکام تربیعات و مقابلات کواکب (تربیع و مقابله مشتری و زحل) دلالت کند بر
lines.en: On the judgments of the squares and oppositions of the planets. (The square and opposition of Jupiter and Saturn) indicates

lines.text: مجادله میان علما و مشایخ و قضاة و اندوه سلاطین و رسوا شدن اهل خیانت و ظهور
lines.en: dispute among scholars, shaykhs, and judges, and the sorrow of sultans, and the disgrace of the treacherous, and the appearance of

lines.text: عداوتها میان بزرگان و ظلم و جور ناکسان بر شرفا و بیماری معارف و توانگران و خراب
lines.en: enmities among the great, and the oppression and tyranny of the base upon the nobles, and the illness of the well-known and the wealthy, and the ruin of

lines.text: جایها و تغییر حال ممالک و تعصب میان اکابر و بد گشتن هوا و تفاوت نرخها و عتاب
lines.en: places, and the change in the condition of kingdoms, and prejudice among the grandees, and the worsening of the weather, and the fluctuation of prices, and the reprimand of

lines.text: و خطاب وزرا با رؤسا و خاندانهای قدیم و خوف صحرانشینان و قلعه داران از اهل
lines.en: and addressing of viziers with the chiefs and ancient families, and the fear of the nomads and the fortress-holders from the people of

lines.text: خروج و ملال عظما و معارف (مقابله باشد) دلالت کند بر خصومت میان پادشاه
lines.en: rebellion, and the weariness of the great and the well-known. (If it is an opposition) it indicates hostility between the king

lines.text: و یکی از عظما و اشراف و ظلم و ستم سلاطین و حکام بر رعیت و فتنه و آشوب و حرکت
lines.en: and one of the great and nobles, and the oppression and tyranny of sultans and rulers upon the subjects, and sedition and tumult, and the movement of

lines.text: سپاه و خرابی در محکمها و کوه پایها و گرفتار شدن ناکسان بدست ناکسان و بیم
lines.en: the army, and ruin in strongholds and foothills, and the capture of the base by the hands of the base, and the fear of

lines.text: انتقال دولت و نهضت سپاهیان بطرف مشرق و تغییر ملك و زد و خورد میان امم
lines.en: the transfer of the state, and the march of armies towards the east, and the change of the kingdom, and fighting among nations,

lines.text: و فساد در دین و مذهب و نهب و غارت خوارج و فساد حال دهاقین و مزارعان و
lines.en: and corruption in religion and sect, and the plunder and looting of the Kharijites, and the corruption of the condition of the peasants and farmers, and

lines.text: بیماری بزرگان خاصه در اقلیم اول و تفاوت نرخها مایل بگرانی و بدی حال هوا *
lines.en: the illness of the great, especially in the first clime, and the fluctuation of prices tending towards dearness, and the bad condition of the weather. *

lines.text: اگر تربیع باشد دلالت بر خصومت اکابر و ستم بر دهاقین و آفت اهل قلاع و اندوه
lines.en: (If it is a square) it indicates hostility of the grandees, and oppression upon the peasants, and calamity for the people of the fortresses, and the sorrow of

lines.text: پادشاهان و فرماندهان و ویرانیها و مصادره اغنیا و توانگران و رونق دار القضا
lines.en: kings and commanders, and ruins, and the confiscation of the rich and wealthy, and the prosperity of the courthouse,

lines.en: and the justice of the market inspectors, and sedition and tumult, and the seeking of commanders and sultans for one another, and

lines.text: سوء حال یکی از قضاة و اهل شرع و بیم خرابی منازل اکابر و کشادن حصارها و
lines.en: the bad condition of one of the judges and people of the law, and the fear of the ruin of the dwellings of the grandees, and the opening of fortresses, and

lines.text: بسیاری خصومت میان علما و اهل تصوف و معتکفان و چله داران و ظهور تعصب

lines.en: monotheism with heretics and infidels, and the killing of the people of innovation and Jews and Christians, and the ruling of kings

lines.text: بکشتن خوارج و اهل طغیان (تربیع و مقابله مریخ و زحل) دلالت کند بر فتنها
lines.en: to kill the Kharijites and the people of rebellion. (The square and opposition of Mars and Saturn) indicates seditions

lines.text: و قتلها و افتادن عداوتها و بدحالی دزدان و راه زنان و قصد و عرض در میان
lines.en: and killings, and the falling of enmities, and the bad condition of thieves and highwaymen, and intention and honor among

lines.text: اکابر و اشراف و حزن و بیم خلایق و بدحالی اهل صحرا و احشام و کوه نشینان و
lines.en: the grandees and nobles, and the sorrow and fear of the creatures, and the bad condition of the people of the desert and livestock and mountain dwellers, and

lines.text: نیکی اهل سلاح و بیماریهای مهلك و نا ایمنی طرق و شوارع و فساد دواب و اندوه

summary.headline: Jupiter–Saturn Squares and Oppositions
summary.text: Chapter Ten discusses astrological judgments for the squares and oppositions of Jupiter–Saturn and Mars–Saturn, predicting political conflict, tyranny, rebellion, warfare, disease, ruined fortresses, religious strife, persecution, unrest, and economic and weather changes.
